sources.title: Archives nationales d’outre-mer: Indochina research guide
sources.note: Original institutional guide directly read, Les fonds territoriaux / Archives de l’administration coloniale jusqu’en 1945. Direct colony under governor distinguished from protectorates under residents superior; union established 1887.

sources.title: Daniel Hémery, A Saigon dans les années trente, un journal militant: La Lutte (1933 to 1937), 2005
sources.note: Full French scholarly essay directly read on Virtual Saigon research portal. Opening, La Lutte dans le système des journaux and final content analysis: 1933 alliance, elections 1933/1935, language-specific press laws and 1936 changes. Interpretive superlatives and disputed numerical estimates of literacy omitted.

sources.title: Montserrat López Jerez, Deltas Apart, Lund University doctoral thesis, 2014
sources.note: Author work, indexed full thesis text pp177 to 179 read at ResearchGate. Identity/publication confirmed in original Lund institutional record e4a1cec0-c08d-4795-a100-efc1c0de929a; its download failed. Section5.3.4, graphs5.1/5.2 distinguish producer/Cholon/export prices, near80% fall1929 to 1934. No numerical decline used publicly; retains comparison as author analysis.

sources.title: Phuong Thao Phan and Thi Binh Nguyen, Sciences et société, BnF France-Vietnam heritage portal
sources.note: Direct scholarly institutional essay, February2021. Agronomy paragraphs26 to 28: Cochinchina rice, seed selection stations and export objectives. Broad celebratory claims and questionable dates or discovery language elsewhere not adopted.

sources.title: Đặng Thị Vân Chi, Vietnamese Women Intellectuals and Global Integration in the First Half of the 20th Century
sources.note: Journal of Mekong Societies11(1),2015,pp21 to 54, original full PDF directly read. Printedpp42 to 44: Gò Công bookshop established1928, family/childcare/science reading; p45 Saigon fair4 to 8May1932 with culinary arts, crafts and relief. Care taken not to relocate Hue association classes to Saigon.

sources.title: ISEAS Yusof Ishak Institute Library: The First Women’s Newspapers in Vietnam
sources.note: Direct original institutional post30March2026. Phụ Nữ Tân Văn section reproduces article heading Phụ nữ nên tự lập, gloss Women should be independent, issue58 June1930. Public sample transcribes this explicitly captioned witness in modern type. Image-link fetch failed; no claim independent image inspection. Source’s opening anachronistic autonomous-republic label is rejected. Combined attribution includes existing french-indo-china card.

sources.title: Nguyễn Thị Minh Hiếu, Cholon’s urban evolution,1879 to 1930: State, Locals, and Trans-locals, ANU thesis,2020
sources.note: Original PDF downloaded and text extracted locally as cholon.pdf.txt. Printed/PDFp104 belongs to1896 chapter(pp101ff); buckets and market-garden waste are earlier context. pp192 to 195 cover interwar housing; plate6.1 and note376 use20September1938 survey, not1930. p193 notes1922 lack of water/sewerage and1930sirens. All three passages budgeted as one thesis.

sources.title: Institut Pasteur: From rabies vaccine to the creation of the Institute
sources.note: Direct original institutional timeline: Saigon branch1891 under Albert Calmette, rabies/smallpox mission, explicitly1930building photograph. Paris/Lille work not relocated to Saigon; no universal vaccine coverage asserted.

sources.title: Indochina statistical yearbook: Anti-rabies institutes in1930
sources.note: Original colonial statistical tableVII, chapterIV, indexed original read. Saigon1228people treated,3deaths; no clinical effectiveness inference. Reproducible query site.seadelt.net "Saïgon" "1.228" "1930". PDF opens but has no extracted text. Runtime annam-1920 reuse counted as same work.

sources.title: ECPAD ImagesDéfense: Blanchard de la Brosse Museum, Saigon
sources.note: Original archival photographic record S51-91 directly read. Museum inaugurated1929; photographs are1951, not interwar. Descriptions identify Khmer stone statuary, Angkorian lintel and Hindu objects. Inconsistent day/month metadata avoided; all dates agree1951.

sources.title: French law49-733 of4June1949, changing Cochin China’s status
sources.note: Official law metadata verified; direct PDF fetch failed. Exact French Articles1 to 3 read in documentary reproduction, printedp106/PDFindex105, https://digital-library.cloudnet.com.kh/storage/media_files/ogE5C6UZqqW4hjozAqypzJoLCKFo7SOl3HbRSqx4.pdf . Only reproduced law used, not surrounding partisan narrative. Article2 attaches territory to associated State of Vietnam and ends overseas-territory status.

sources.title: US Department of State, Foreign Relations1949VII(1), document35
sources.note: Original6June1949 diplomatic memorandum directly read. Discusses March8 Bao Dai agreement, territorial unity of Tonkin/Annam/Cochinchina, continuing resistance and dispute over sovereignty. Public ending does not endorse its Cold War polemic or imply all Vietnamese accepted the new state.
